Experiments show that the proposed

triplets.subject: Our Method
triplets.evidence_span:
Unlike recent approaches that
rely on large decoder-based LLMs for hallucination
detection (Su et al., 2025; Niu et al., 2024; Mishra
et al., 2024), our method employs a lightweight encoder model, making inference considerably more
efficient.
